plan_review.notes: Adopted explicit V1 family curves (weapon-linear-percent, armor-linear-percent, no-inherent) selected per normalized base instead of an implicit global fallback; deferred the single nearest-half-up normalization until after all resolved effects; made Rare weighting explicit as an equal draw between available one-two-unit and two-one-unit shapes followed by a canonical combination draw; constrained V1 stat effects to add-only and mirrored grant arrays from resolved effects. The runtime-consumer concern is resolved by scope: rewards, merchants, drops, UX, and AI are explicitly excluded generation sources, so no production caller is invented; integration uses a configured real GameWorld registry plus C1 activation and C2 grant/revoke APIs, with explicit unconfigured-world failure coverage.
